description: This file contains utility functions related to systemd, including checks for systemd status, retrieving systemd unit names, and machine IDs, primarily used for systemd environment detection and information retrieval.

methods.name: GetRunningSlice
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the systemd slice in which the current process is running.

methods.name: RunningFromSystemService
methods.description: Detects whether the current process has been invoked from a system service.

methods.name: CurrentUnitName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the systemd system unit associated with the current process.

methods.name: IsRunningSystemd
methods.description: Checks whether the host was booted with systemd as its init system.

methods.name: GetMachineID
methods.description: Returns the host's 128-bit machine ID as a string.
